bio_en: Suren Melikian was born in Baku on 26 May 1895, the son of the public figure H. Melikian. In 1905 he was sent to the Chateau de Lancy school in Geneva, where he also took Armenian lessons from the poet Siamanto, and he studied history and political science at the Sorbonne in 1912-14. On the outbreak of war he returned, and in 1915 was in Tiflis, writing for Horizon and translating Barby's book on the Armenian massacres. During the Republic he went on a mission to America, then returned to the front; after Sovietisation he was arrested by the Cheka in Tiflis and killed.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Text truncated; date of his death not read (after Feb 1921 judging by the Tiflis Cheka).
